title: Pete Procopio, Glenn Drewes and no longer playing fast
summary: Greetings to Pete Procopio and Pete's 'who wants to play fast' remark.

blocks.x: Well Ronnie, I’ve got a kick out of this hang.
Hey one thing, if I don’t say hello from Pete Procopio I’m going to be —
Oh man, yeah you too, please say hello to him for me.
Yeah Pete. There was a trumpet player in the band, Glenn Drewes
Yes, yes, yes, and that band he — © Fillius Jazz Archive -20-

He does a lot of stuff in New York. He’s the lead trumpet player in the show I’m doing. And every once in a while he calls Pete up and puts me on the phone, once in a while when we’re having a couple of drinks you know. And the last conversation I had with him I ended it with, “Pete I can’t play fast anymore man.” He says, “Who wants to play fast?” he says. You know you get, it’s like after Woody man I got to the point where I could play real fast you know, and when you don’t, if you don’t do it you lose it.
